name: The New Rich Family Grudge
overview: The Walton’s is a mercenary family that has been profiting from various illegitimate businesses and bribing the police for protection. After Phil Walton's father retired, the Walton family let Phil take over the family industry. The who story began when Phil married his second wife which caused Phil’s daughter to be extremely dissatisfied. This second wife was an elite on the surface, but was actually a liar of unknown origin. Since then, many ludicrous murders and kidnappings and other events have occurred in the Walton family, which gradually revealed the resentment of the rich families.
